The original list of 29 Facebook groups that started the Virtual Reality Media Alliance 29 Facebook groups in descending order of membership size. medium.com

A list of Facebook Pages that I very casually maintain now added to the VRMA Virtual Reality Media… Gear VR https://www.facebook.com/Gear-VR-588869044624254/ medium.com

Here is the form to join VRMA https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfToi5KoXqLVMZ7_w1G2NhXDbFya0snvpbldswPmQEV0dKkBA/viewform?usp=sf_link
